resources.string: SMS Payments Bridge reads your SMS.

It reads text messages from the bank and M-Pesa senders your company\'s ERPNext lists, and sends them to your company\'s ERPNext server at %1$s to record payments. Messages from any other sender are never sent, unless you choose them yourself in Send samples. You can stop it at any time by uninstalling the app.
Tap ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then come back.
